'''Zdzisław Józef Porosiński''' (19 March 1955 in [[Kłodzko]], [[Poland]] – 19 March 2016 in [[Wrocław]], [[Poland]])<ref>{{cite web|title=''Grave record for Zdzisław Porosiński (19 March 1955 – 26 March 2016), BillionGraves Record 21129153 Wrocław, wrocławski, dolnośląskie, Poland''|url=https://pl.billiongraves.com/grave/Zdzis%C5%82aw-Porosi%C5%84ski/21129153}}</ref> was a Polish [[mathematician]] and [[statistician]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Skarupski |first=Marek |title=Porosiński, Zdzisław (19 iii 1955 Kłodzko-26 iii 2016 Wrocław). Słownik biograficzny matematyków polskich |publisher=Polska Akademia Umiejętności |year=2024 |isbn=978-83-7676-374-3 |editor-last=Duda |editor-first=Roman |edition=1st |location=Kraków |pages=232 |language=pl}}</ref>

== Biography ==
In 1979, he graduated in mathematics from Faculty of Fundamental Problems of Technology, [[Wrocław University of Technology]] with a master's degree. After graduation, he started working at his alma mater at the Institute of Mathematics (later renamed Institute of Mathematics and Informatics of the [[Wrocław University of Technology]], and from 2015 transformed into the Faculty of Pure and Applied Mathematics). On 17 March 1987, he defended his doctoral dissertation entitled S''elected problems of optimal stopping ''.<ref name=NPolska>{{cite web|title=dr hab. inż. Zdzisław Józef Porosiński|url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=60374&_k=7udzt0|website=Nowa Nauka Polska|publisher=National Information Processing Institute|access-date=19 July 2017|language=pl-PL}}</ref> The research supervisor and thesis supervisor was professor [[Stanisław Trybuła]]. On 20 November 2003, the habilitation colloquium was held. On 31 May 2004, he obtained a postdoctoral degree in mathematical sciences. In the years 2001–2008 he worked at the Institute of Basic Sciences State Higher Vocational School in [[Nysa, Poland|Nysa]]. In the years 2006–2012 he was the deputy director for didactics at Institute of Mathematics and Computer Science of the [[Wrocław University of Technology]]. From 2009 he was a professor [[Wrocław University of Technology]].<ref>{{cite journal
|journal=Wiadomości Matematyczne. Annales Societatis Mathematicae Polonae
|series=II|volume=LIII|number=2|year=2017|first1=Agnieszka|last1=Kamińska|author-link1=Agnieszka Kamińska
|first2=Krzysztof|last2=Szajowski|author-link2= Krzysztof Szajowski
|title=Zdzisław Porosiński (1955–2016)
|pages=401–403
|url= https://wydawnictwa.ptm.org.pl/index.php/wiadomosci-matematyczne/article/download/6420/5915
|issn=2080-5519}}</ref>

== Contributions ==
His research contributions include over 40 papers.<ref name=ZPMathSciNet>{{cite web|title=Zdzisław Józef Porosiński|url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/search/author.html?mrauthid=141240|website=[[MathSciNet]]|publisher=American Mathematical Society|access-date=19 January 2021|language=en-EN}}</ref><ref name=ZPzbMath>{{cite web|title=Porosiński, Zdzisław|url=https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai%3Aporosinski.zdzislaw|website=[[zbMath]]|publisher=FIZ Karlsruhe GmbH|access-date=19 January 2021|language=en-EN}}</ref> His work in probability theory included work on optimal stopping of the sequences of random variables and the statistics of stochastic processes. The most cited results concern the optimal strategies for the optimal stopping problem when the decision horizon is random.<ref name=ZPSPA1987>{{cite journal
|first=Zdzisław |last=Porosiński |title=The full-information best choice problem with a random number of observations
|journal = Stochastic Process. Appl.
|volume = 24 |issue = 2 
|pages = 293–307 |issn=0304-4149
|date=March 1987
|doi= 10.1016/0304-4149(87)90020-2
|doi-access=}}</ref> He was the doctoral advisor of one student{{r|NPolska}}{{r|GPPorosinski}}.
